attributes.converted: Debt census 56 -> 18 bare_sites (67.9% reduction; 24 sites now offsetof/sizeof-named, the remaining 14 fully absorbed into -> member access which the census regex does not match at all). Added #include "game/mbobject.h" and a local offsetof() guard macro (matching enemy.c/pb_frame.c convention). Extended the file-local animdata struct with PDB-verified ppos[4]@0x40/xpos[4]@0x60 (Xbox graphics.h struct 'animdata', exact 0xA0 size match; GC-verified against AnimFixPos's existing root-motion X/Z-zero pattern, which already zeroed the parallel MBObject.mat[3][0]/[2] translation fields) - kept the pre-existing 'inuse' field name (offset 0x04, PDB spells it 'used') unchanged per the no-rename constraint on this claim. Five previously-100%-matched functions converted to named MBObject/animdata/animseqdesc field access with zero regression (verified real 0 / OK throughout): AtreeNodeInit (node->obj mat[3][0..2] writes), DoAnimateTree via its inlined AnimFixPos helper (child->obj mat[3][0]/[2], child->anim ppos/xpos X/Z zeroing), AnimateNode (info->seqheader[...].flags, mirroring DoAnimateTree's own sibling form), AtreeFindMbidxNode/AtreeFindMbidxNodeChild (node->obj->index), AtreeRemoveNodeSub (node->anim->parent/->type, MB_PSYS_NODE enum). fn_8001267C (the parked resource-header fixup, 44 of the 56 census sites): converted the match-list/texmod-table/node-def/node-info/sequence-table/blob-header regions to offsetof(atreematch|TEXMOD|AtreeNodeDef|animseqdesc|AtreeDefinition, field) or sizeof() spelling on the SAME raw pointers (no typed intermediates introduced anywhere in this function, deliberately, given its REGISTER_ONLY/SCHEDULE park), plus removed 3 fully-redundant `*(u32*)&blob[N]` round-trip casts (blob is already s32*, so blob[N] alone is the identical lvalue) and 3 dead offset-shadow accumulators (off/seqoff replaced by i*sizeof(...)/j*sizeof(...) where the shadow always equaled the loop counter times the stride). This produced a genuine matching side-effect, not separately probed: fn_8001267C real 1008->902 (10.5% real-diff-line reduction) and fuzzy 80.69044%->81.7374%, insn count held exactly (575/565 -> 575/565), no opcode-multiset change. All conversions gated individually in 6 small batches via defake_gate.py check --rebuild --update-improved; zero regressions across the whole pass. Full ninja green, main.dol: OK, git diff --check clean.

claim.law.recomputed-index-array-form-safe (applied: the node-def/node-info/sequence-table loops all recompute their per-iteration pointer fresh from i*sizeof/j*sizeof rather than an accumulated pointer, matching the safe case - converted cleanly, 2 of 3 batches improved real); claim.law.dead-offset-shadow-removal-safe (applied in those same 3 loops - off/seqoff always equaled the loop counter times the struct stride and had no other use, deleted along with the redundant accumulation); claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing (screened and deliberately AVOIDED its failure mode: the TEXMOD (8 fields) and AtreeNodeDef (8 fields) loops are exactly the walked/indexed-base-with-2+-nearby-fields shape this law warns about, so no typed intermediate pointer was introduced there - offsetof-on-raw-pointer only, per its own prescribed counter-form); claim.law.declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast (applied AND REFINED - see the new law record filed alongside this attempt: the declared-alias counter-form regressed AtreeNodeInit and DoAnimateTree/AnimFixPos, both plain non-walked pointer WRITE sites where the raw source had no pre-existing shared variable; reverting to a fresh inline cast per site restored byte-identity in both, and that repeated-cast form is what shipped); claim.law.pointer-walk-array-index-regression (screened: no accumulator-walked pointer, i.e. a variable advanced via += across loop iterations and reused, was converted to indexed form anywhere in this TU; not triggered); claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention (screened: no lwzu-fusable p+=CONST load-with-update idiom exists anywhere in this TU's raw sites; not applicable); claim.law.offsetof-fused-immediate-counter (applied: AtreeNodeDef.position[0..2] used the offsetof(Outer,field)+N*sizeof(elem) form rather than offsetof(Outer,field[N]), matching the law's stated idiom); claim.law.offsetof-rename-array-member-boundary (screened: no raw offset on an array-typed struct MEMBER reached via -> decay was offsetof-converted - AtreeNodeDef.position is reached via a raw u8* base, not obj->arrayfield+N; not triggered); claim.law.offsetof-rename-isolated-site-outlier (screened: gated every region separately rather than spot-checking a batch, per its caution; no isolated outlier surfaced - every region held or improved); claim.law.offsetof-overturns-typed-alias-caps (not applicable: fn_8001267C's only recorded cap is a bare REGISTER_ONLY/SCHEDULE residual note, not an undocumented failed-conversion-form cap, so there was no typed-alias cap to overturn); claim.law.scalar-read-write-lfsu-mixed-form (screened: no scalar read-immediately-followed-by-write-to-the-same-address pair was converted - the SWAP16/32 macros mutate one lvalue in place, and the AtreeNodeInit/AnimFixPos writes are pure stores of already-computed values, not read-then-write pairs; not applicable); claim.law.walked-base-symbol-identity (screened: hdr/blob/tm/seq/ni are all local pointers/parameters in this TU, never a dual-symbol-aliased global blob; not applicable); claim.law.large-fn-batch-fuzzy-can-mask-subfield-regression (not applicable: fn_8001267C is 575 insns, far under the ~4000-insn threshold;
